description: Apply the mechanical fixes for review findings instead of editing them one by one: api/coroutine-without-await, api/freed-check-order, api/get-meta-null-default, api/infer-variant, api/multimesh-format-after-count, api/timer-start-outside-tree, quality/mojibake, quality/standalone-ternary, quality/string-signal. Each fix rewrites only the line a finding points to, only when it looks exactly as expected, and is labelled `safe` (it only removes the problem: a freed check put first, get_meta() with has_meta(), a lone ternary as if/else, text encoded twice decoded, emit_signal() as signal.emit(), a MultiMesh format moved before instance_count, Timer.start() moved after add_child(), weakref() typed WeakRef) or `check` (it changes more: an await added to a coroutine call makes its caller a coroutine; a guessed type). Without `write` it shows the changes; with `write: true` it applies them and reviews the changed files again, returning what is left. Only safe fixes unless `include_check: true`. Lines it cannot fix are listed with the reason. Run godot_review first to see the findings, and godot_check after writing.

detail.description: brief: short output with capped lists; full: everything (default for this cheap profile: brief).

include_check.description: also apply fixes labelled check (default false)

path.description: The project folder, or any file or folder inside it (Godotwright walks up to project.godot). Relative paths start at the server's folder. Default: the current project.

rules.description: only these rules (fixable: api/coroutine-without-await, api/freed-check-order, api/get-meta-null-default, api/infer-variant, api/multimesh-format-after-count, api/timer-start-outside-tree, quality/mojibake, quality/standalone-ternary, quality/string-signal)

write.description: write the fixes (default false: show them only)

name: godot_fix
title: Fix review findings mechanically
